kind: measured baseline defects and their closure
whatWasChecked: the five evidence-binding defects an independent review identified in the G1 producer, measured against the unmodified G1 code and re-measured after the corrections

defects.requirement: exactly one Port Invocation Identity must name one actual Deployment Port execution and all observations associated with it
defects.baselineDefect: Work Delegation minted its own `wpi-<uuid>` for the correlated entry while the Deployment Port minted a DIFFERENT `wpi-<uuid>` for each observation, so one port execution carried two unrelated invocation identities
defects.correction: the Deployment Port remains the sole producer of InvocationId; the Work Delegation correlation wrapper adopts the invocationId carried by the port observation instead of generating one
defects.invariant: entry.invocationId === entry.observation.invocationId, and every observation from one port run shares one invocationId

defects.requirement: real Spawn/PID/Exit observations must be preserved, read back and validated as actual events; a successfully written empty record must never count as process evidence
defects.baselineDefect: the recorder rejected all three real observations (invocation mismatch), and the resulting zero-event record still wrote successfully and reported durabilityVerified: true
defects.correction: the recorder ingests the actual correlated events from the active sink; a positive qualification requires acceptedEvents > 0, rejectedEvents = 0, persistedEventCount === acceptedEvents, and a readback of the same count; per-invocation run-scoped storage replaces the single fixed file
defects.invariant: a record with zero events cannot satisfy the process-lifecycle edge

defects.requirement: the correlator must consume the real frozen `kind/payload` journal structure through the existing Journal Reader, validate the run-root claim, and reject missing, malformed or duplicate identities
defects.baselineDefect: readRunIdentity() and readTrialIdentities() matched flattened `type/runId` fields, so on real journal records they returned MISSING_RUN_STARTED and an empty trial map
defects.correction: the correlator reads `{seq, kind, at, payload, digest}` records through `readJournal()`, requires JOURNAL_INTACT, requires exactly one RUN_STARTED with a usable payload.runId, verifies the run-root claim through `verifyTrustedClaim()`, and reads `payload.sessionId` / `payload.record.attemptId` / `payload.record.hostJobId`
defects.invariant: no synthetic flattened journal format is used as the positive path

defects.requirement: caller-created JSON, even with a copied origin marker and a recomputed SHA-256, must not qualify as a host-origin observation through the authority-bearing consumer
defects.baselineDefect: a caller-built record with origin `G1_LOCAL_RECORDER`, a recomputed recordDigest and an EMPTY event array reached RUN_ATTEMPT_CORRELATED against a matching journal
defects.correction: trusted ingestion is separated from untrusted inspection: a record reaches LOCAL_HOST_OBSERVED only through the recorder handle bound to a live local invocation, and RUN_ATTEMPT_CORRELATED additionally requires non-empty validated persisted events plus a verified claim and journal reconciliation
defects.invariant: a copied marker plus a self-computed digest can only reach DECLARATION_ONLY or ORIGIN_NOT_ESTABLISHED

defects.requirement: the locator must accept the real Work Owner canonical `attempt-<32hex>` identity and fail closed on incomplete discovery
defects.baselineDefect: passing the canonical `attempt-<32hex>` returned ABSENT (the comparison used the bare hex), and a candidate below the scan bound returned ABSENT with no indication that the search was incomplete
defects.correction: the comparison normalizes both the canonical and the bare-hex forms under one explicit contract, and a traversal that could not scan every directory reports DISCOVERY_INCOMPLETE rather than a successful exhaustive search
defects.invariant: canonical AttemptId works directly; a partially scanned space is never reported as globally unique

law: a defect is reported PRESENT only when the actual code produced the actual wrong answer, and CLOSED only when the same measurement no longer reproduces it
